purpose: Fresh terse player-language companion to final Gate 3 tranche S.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored only after production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded for v071-qa-20260919-30 and after the Rules Arbiter historical regression gate passed on main; it was not used to construct r30.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade tranche S after its first paid live run; preserve that run as immutable final blind evidence.
Any failed tranche-S case may become regression coverage only after diagnosis; the first S run remains the certification evidence.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N/O/P/Q/R questions.
Question-scoped semantic criteria require only what the question asks; do not require unasked costs, frequencies, consequences, or context.
Citation/classification mismatches must be distinguished from semantically wrong rulings during closeout.
expectedSourceGroups are OR-lists within a governing requirement; separate groups remain independently required.
